evidence.rationale: The system has a 0% execution rate with the dominant veto reason being 'robust_z_above_entry_threshold' (150+ unique tickers). A threshold of -2.0 is too restrictive, suppressing nearly all trade frequency. Loosening to -1.75 maintains a strong mean-reversion signal while allowing candidates with z-scores between -1.75 and -2.0 to pass, meaningfully increasing trade frequency without materially degrading signal quality.
